name: arrival-pack
title: Reception arrival pack
for_each: select id,name from sites order by code

sections.title: Expected visitors
sections.sql: select v.code,v.visitor_name,v.company,h.name as host,v.purpose,v.expected_at,v.status from visits v left join hosts h on h.id=v.host_id where v.site_id=$1 and v.status in ('pending','approved') and v.expected_at<now()+interval '7 days' order by v.expected_at

sections.title: Site rules
sections.note: Retention days and maximum visit length are operator policy, not statutory periods.

name: visitor-pass
title: Visitor pass
for_each: select id,code from visits where status='onsite' order by code

sections.title: Visit details
sections.note: Reception record only. This pass does not grant physical access.

name: retention-review
title: Visitor retention review
for_each: select id,name from sites order by code

sections.title: Records requiring a decision
sections.sql: select code,visitor_name,status,retention_due,hold_reason from visits where site_id=$1 and retention_due<=current_date and status<>'redacted' order by retention_due
sections.note: Review lawful purpose and holds before redaction. Include exports, drafts and backups in disposal.

name: visit-history
title: Visit record and decisions
for_each: select id,code from visits where status<>'redacted' order by code

sections.title: Recorded decisions
sections.sql: select event,actor,created_at from visit_events where visit_id=$1 order by created_at,id
